Messages.Author: Obtenebration
Messages.Body:
On Sep 10, 9:04 pm, matt...@gmail.com wrote:
> Must the minon getting hit by a strike modified by a Target card be
> able to play the cards discarded to cancel.

Target Vitals
Type: Combat
Aim. Play when choosing a strike.
If any damage from this strike is successfully inflicted on the
opposing minion, he or she takes an additional 2 damage from this
strike, and he or she cannot press this round. The opposing minion may
discard two combat cards [COMBAT] to cancel this card. A minion may
play only one aim each strike.

Card text says discard 2 combat cards. No clause that says the minion
has to be able to play them.

Although I wonder if it should say the opposing minion's controller/
methuselah can discard the two cards, since minions don't have cards
in hand to discard exactly.

> With the current rule of  able to play as if X
> Can a Shadow Court Satyr w/ Amaranth now diablerize a vampire going to
> torpor?
>

I believe the rulebook specifically states this doesn't work, and that
only a vampire can commit diablerie.

"13) Only vampires may commit diablerie. Effects that would allow
something
other than a vampire to commit diablerie are ignored. For example,
Amaranth
is useless if played on a Shadow Court Satyr. "

Taken from:
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/browse_thread/thread/ccb04e95f381962/1a1d8e5e3f69d109?lnk=gst&q=amaranth+shadow+court+satyr#1a1d8e5e3f69d109

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:


It's a specific exception, because it leads to weird and bad things.
For one - either the ally is treated as a vampire throughout the
entire diablerie, which means that you could put a skill card on the
ally, and what the hell does that mean (I guess it would do nothing at
all, but it still doesn't make sense), and then do you get the blood
off the opposing vampire and what's the ally's capacity for that
blood? Or, he's not treated like a vampire and thus there wouldn't be
a bloodhunt, which is bad, because you couldn't even burn him with
anything like Carlton Van Wyk or 6th Tradition or what have you. And
so on. All in all, an ally committing diablerie is just stupid, which
is why it's not allowed. =)
